Title: Updates to profiler and tracing capabilities in Azure Monitor Application Insights

Body.Content:
The ability to specify CPU and memory thresholds for the Application Insights Profiler is now available, so you now have better control of when to collect traces. 

We've also added a preview of the source code view (via decompilation) in Application Insights Snapshot Debugger to allow you to quickly diagnose the failing code.

Learn more
